info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows the removal of declined credit card applications from the system. It enables businesses to maintain up-to-date records by effectively managing declined applications. Typical consumers of this API may include financial institutions, credit processing systems, and application management platforms that require accurate application status management. By using this API, organizations can streamline their workflows and ensure their application data is relevant and current.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to decline a specific application by sending a DELETE request. It is vital for managing the application status and ensuring effective workflow operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for declining an application. The structure defined in the schema outlines the required fields and their expected data types.

200.description: The application has been successfully declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: This schema represents the request body for declining an application in the DELETE operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.title: Application Decline Response

status.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the decline operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the decline operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the decline operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the decline operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the decline operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: Response schema for the decline operation of an application.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user who created the decline operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the decline operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Contains information related to the audit of the decline operation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the total processing time (in milliseconds) for the request. A value of 0 suggests that the operation completed almost instantaneously.
